descriptions.zh:
- 本接口用于创建边缘转码任务。

- 用户需要具有访问边缘转码服务的权限，才能正常调用本接口。
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为6000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation to create an edge transcoding job.

- Before you call this operation, you must have permission to access the edge transcoding service.

## QPS limits

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 6,000 calls per minute for each user. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled, which can affect your business. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live create-edge-transcode-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id 0000003b-4d18-395c-8106-ff21a6000000 --name task1 --template-id 000096e8864746a0b6f30000 --stream-input rtmp://mydomain/app/stream1 --stream-output rtmp://testdomain/app/stream2 --region cn-hangzhou
